title: Kernel Forge：基于LLM的CUDA内核生成与优化智能体框架
summary: Kernel Forge是一个开源端到端智能体框架，可直接接受未修改的PyTorch模型，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索探索多条优化路径，支持视觉、扩散和LLM工作负载，并提供图形界面监控和调试。在NVIDIA DGX Spark上对四个模型进行测试，优化14个内核，性能提升达1.52倍至2.83倍。
summary_en: Kernel Forge is an open-source end-to-end agentic harness that accepts unmodified PyTorch models, uses Monte Carlo Tree Search to explore multiple optimization paths, supports vision, diffusion, and LLM workloads, and provides a GUI for monitoring and debugging. Evaluated on four PyTorch models, it optimizes 14 kernels achieving 1.52x to 2.83x speedups over PyTorch eager mode.
